summary: Frontend-only Expo web review completed. The centered clipped LED button, overlap guard, ~16.8s reset, re-activation, and exactly-once performAction logging pass. Core visual LED animation fails on web: all 221 polygon fill attributes/computed fills remain green throughout; only the surrounding halo/gaps change color.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: LED polygons never transition green→yellow→red→yellow on Expo web. At every checkpoint (100ms through red phase), all 221 polygons retained fill rgba(39, 214, 79, 1) and computed fill rgb(39, 214, 79). Screenshots appear phase-tinted only because the animated halo shows through the LED gaps; there is no per-LED randomized color stagger.

accessibilityValue.text is not emitted to the web DOM (no aria-valuetext in Ready or running states), so Ready/Preparing/Active/Completing status is unavailable to assistive technology. aria-disabled does update correctly while running.

action_items: Fix react-native-reanimated/react-native-svg web color updates so each polygon's actual fill transitions with the randomized delays; verify DOM computed fills include mixed colors mid-transition and fully settle at each target color.
Expose phase text with a web-supported accessibility mechanism (for example an explicit aria-valuetext mapping) and verify it changes across phases.
critical_code_review_comments: AnimatedLed uses useAnimatedProps to set Polygon.fill, but in this Expo 57/Reanimated 4 web runtime those animated props never reach the SVG DOM. The sibling halo driven by useAnimatedStyle does animate, isolating the defect to the SVG animated-props path. Use a documented web-compatible SVG color approach (such as the appropriate color prop adapter or animated CSS/currentColor strategy) and regression-test real polygon fills.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6 of 7 requested behaviors passed; the failed behavior is the primary visible color sequence)

context_for_next_testing_agent: No frontend/.env or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was present, so browser tests used the running Expo preview at http://127.0.0.1:3000. Mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080 layouts passed centering/size checks. Exactly-once logs occurred around 3.6-3.9s; the control returned to tabindex=0 after ~16.8s and a second activation produced exactly one additional log. Re-test polygon fill attributes/computed styles, not only the halo appearance.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: load the web preview, inspect [data-testid='traffic-light-button'] svg polygon fills, tap, and sample during yellow/red phases. Every polygon remains rgba(39, 214, 79, 1) while the halo changes phase color and performAction fires. Source isolation: TrafficLightButton's useAnimatedStyle halo works, while AnimatedLed's useAnimatedProps fill does not update react-native-svg Polygon on web. This indicates a Reanimated 4/react-native-svg web prop-delivery compatibility or adapter issue, not a state-machine/timer failure.
